description: This file provides a fake implementation of the UserDataRepository interface for testing purposes. It interacts with a mocked data source (NiaPreferencesDataSource) to simulate user data operations such as updating preferences and settings without needing a real backend.

classes.name: FakeUserDataRepository
classes.description: A fake implementation of UserDataRepository for testing, which delegates data operations to a mocked data source.

methods.name: userData
methods.description: Property that provides a Flow of UserData, sourced from the data source.

methods.name: setFollowedTopicIds
methods.description: Updates the set of followed topic IDs in the data source.

methods.name: setTopicIdFollowed
methods.description: Marks a specific topic as followed or unfollowed.

methods.name: setNewsResourceBookmarked
methods.description: Bookmarks or unbookmarks a news resource.

methods.name: setNewsResourceViewed
methods.description: Marks a news resource as viewed or not.

methods.name: setShouldHideOnboarding
methods.description: Hides or shows the onboarding screen.
